title: {{send_tool}} — output
description: Output schema for the SOX send operation. Returned as soon as the backing store durably accepts the message. A successful response guarantees the message is immediately visible to all matching watch loops and subsequent recv calls (backing-store send-atomicity contract). Normative reference: CONTRACTS.md §5.1 and spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.1.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the backing store accepted the message. This is the canonical timestamp used for per-channel ordering in recv responses.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for the message just sent. Use this as the correlation_id for thread channels (thread:<message_id>) or as the reference in sox-ack/sox-nack bodies.
